seasonality.method: Each monthly price divided by its calendar-year mean, times 100. Descriptive month-of-year pattern, not a causal seasonal estimate. The grade-consistent period contains 17 complete years.

caveats: Upstream iron-ore price, not high-purity iron or ferroboron purchase price.
Spot ore specification changes from 63.5% Fe to 62% Fe in December 2008; traces are separated.
The workbook header retains a historical dmtu unit label; its Description sheet identifies 2006 onward spot prices as USD/dry ton.
Prices are nominal, not inflation adjusted.
Rare-earth and boron annual quotations cannot establish monthly seasonality.
